tasks.title: Doctor diagnosis
tasks.prompt: Run or inspect a fixture where doctor/health should diagnose a seeded local issue. Report the diagnosis, evidence, and next action.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must surface actionable diagnosis for the seeded issue.
forbidden_claims: Generic OK is enough for seeded issue.

tasks.title: Rebuild vector index
tasks.prompt: Run or inspect a vector-index recovery fixture. Record missing/stale index diagnosis, rebuild action, and after-state evidence.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must prove vector rebuild recovery with after-state evidence.
required_facts: Missing or stale vector index is detected.
After state proves recovery or failure.

tasks.title: Vector mismatch detection
tasks.prompt: Run or inspect a vector mismatch fixture. Report expected state, actual state, diagnosis, and next action.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must detect mismatch instead of treating it as normal empty result.
forbidden_claims: Mismatch is a successful empty result.

tasks.title: Missing cache or transport
tasks.prompt: Run or inspect a missing cache or transport failure fixture. Report diagnosis, current guidance, and any forbidden obsolete fallback guidance.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must diagnose missing cache/transport and avoid obsolete daily CLI fallback.
forbidden_claims: Use removed daily wake/search/timeline CLI as fallback.
Transport failure is successful runtime behavior.

tasks.title: False success recovery guard
tasks.prompt: Inspect a fixture where recovery text appears successful but the after state is still broken. Report false-success count and missing proof.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must count false success as failure.
